text:
Ava (marketing PM): Quick sync — Sunrise case study is almost ready. Attached transcript and two quote options. Need legal OK on the quote + customer final signoff by EOD Thu if we want to include in next Wednesday's launch post. Also planning a co-marketing webinar with them on Apr 9 — who's owning invites + landing page?

Liam (producer): Taking landing page + asset delivery. Timeline: hero quote by Tue COB, transcript edits Wed AM, design ready Thu.

Priya (legal): Please paste the exact quote we'll publish. Watch for product claims re: "100% faster" — need evidence or reword. Also confirm we have rights to publish customer logo.

Ava (marketing PM): Quote option A below. Option B is shorter.

Liam (producer): ```Option A: "Redwood reduced our inference costs by 72% and cut tail latency in half — we shipped faster."```

Priya (legal): Replace "reduced our inference costs by 72%" with "significantly reduced inference costs" unless we add the benchmark doc. Also change "shipped faster" to "accelerated deployment timelines." Then :thumbsup: if everyone ok.

Ethan (growth): For inbound routing: can we route Sunrise demo requests to SDR queue #sunrise? I can add nurture sequence and tagging; also need UTM on webinar landing page.

marketing-bot: Added task #MKT-489 to project board: "Sunrise case study legal check & launch assets"

Liam (producer): Updated short quote for hero banner: ```"Sunrise cut inference cost and latency with Redwood, speeding our model rollout."```

Priya (legal): Short hero quote is fine, but remove "cut" -> "reduced". Final: "Sunrise reduced inference cost and latency with Redwood, speeding our model rollout." I'm OK with that pending customer signoff on wording and logo rights.

Ava (marketing PM): Thanks. @Ethan please confirm SDR queue exists and we have opt-in language for webinar signups. @Liam I need final hero quote in Figma by Thu 10am. I'll ping customer for signoff now.

Ethan (growth): Confirmed queue exists. Will add opt-in snippet: "By registering you agree to be contacted about Redwood products." UTM params: ?utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=partner&utm_campaign=sunrise_launch

Liam (producer): Noted, Figma file link: https://redwood.app/figma/sunrise-case-hero — will drop assets.

Ava (marketing PM): Great — team, please react when you confirm. Priya: if you can post final legal approval here, I'll schedule the publish and webinar invite.

Priya (legal): Approved as edited. :white_check_mark:

Ava (marketing PM): Awesome — I'll follow up with customer and finalize publish slot. Thanks everyone.
